Name: Hire Skilled Helpers
Author: CleanpupC
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Hire Skilled Helpers[/b][/size]
Build a crew. Share the workload.[/center]

Hire customizable helpers who visibly travel to their jobs, work around your farm, and grow alongside you. From watering crops to fishing and dungeon work, your crew gives you more time to enjoy the valley.

[size=4][b]Five professions, one growing crew[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Farmer[/b] — Water, harvest, and tend your crops.[/*]
[*][b]Forager[/b] — Gather forage, chop trees and hardwood, and clear debris.[/*]
[*][b]Miner[/b] — Break rocks, mine ore and gems, and search for ladders in supported mining areas.[/*]
[*][b]Fisher[/b] — Fish in your chosen area, with catches based on the location and fishing conditions.[/*]
[*][b]Fighter[/b] — Fight monsters or take an exploration assignment for combat rewards.[/*]
[/list]Exploration assignments simulate an expedition from a dungeon entrance. Physical combat and mining use their own active jobs.

[size=4][b]Make every helper your own[/b][/size]
Choose a name, appearance, and profession when hiring. Want a different role later? Change their profession from the worker profile while keeping their skills, perks, health, stamina, and gathered items. Switching roles cancels the previous job and daily order, leaving them ready for a new assignment.

[size=4][b]Manage your crew in one place[/b][/size]
Press [b]B[/b] to open the business menu once hiring is unlocked.
[list]
[*][b]Roster[/b] — Select helpers and view their profession, daily wage, location, health, and stamina.[/*]
[*][b]Jobs[/b] — Choose assignments and supported work areas.[/*]
[*][b]Skills[/b] — Check all five skill levels and progress, with a separate Perks tab.[/*]
[*][b]Storage[/b] — Choose where each helper delivers their gathered items.[/*]
[/list]Drag the menu edges or corners to resize it. Your chosen size is remembered for the current session.

Daily orders repeat each morning. When a daytime job is finished, the helper switches to idle and uses normal farm wandering; the original order returns the following day.

[size=4][b]Skills and perks[/b][/size]
Helpers earn skill experience through their work. More to come in future Updates
[list]
[*][b]Endurance[/b] — Reach level 5 in Farming, Foraging, Mining, or Fishing to double maximum stamina from 270 to 540. This bonus unlocks once and does not stack across skills.[/*]
[*][b]Vitality[/b] — Reach Combat level 5 to double maximum health from 100 to 200.[/*]
[/list]Skills and unlocked perks stay with the helper when their profession changes.

[size=4][b]Stamina that follows the work[/b][/size]
Watering, axe and pickaxe hits, and fishing casts consume stamina using player-equivalent action costs with the helper's relevant skill level. Sword and scythe actions, harvesting, forage pickups, and loose gems cost no stamina.

Exhausted helpers rest, recover stamina while idle, and resume their assignment when ready. Health and stamina bars let you check their condition directly in the worker profile.

[size=4][b]Hiring and wages[/b][/size]
Hiring costs [b]500g per helper[/b], including that day's wages. After that, each helper costs [b]100g every morning ( subject to change in update)[/b], including idle days.

If you cannot pay, the affected helpers stop working until you settle their wages through the business menu. Their daily wage is shown beneath their name.

[size=4][b]A welcome from Mayor Lewis[/b][/size]
A standalone Lewis visit becomes available from [b]Spring 8, Year 1[/b], granting permission to hire farmhands. The visit can happen later if you miss that date.

Prefer to get started immediately? The optional Generic Mod Config Menu integration includes a toggle to bypass the permission event and enable the mod's features.

[size=4][b]A livelier farm[/b][/size]
Helpers have customizable appearances, visible work animations, idle farm wandering, and a varied dialogue pool. Their roster, daily orders, skills, perks, and work progress are saved with your farm.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Use Stardew Valley 1.6 with SMAPI 4.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Close Stardew Valley and SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the HireSkilledHelpers folder into your game's Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Receive Lewis's permission, or enable the bypass through Generic Mod Config Menu, then press B to manage your crew.[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for the in-game bypass setting.

[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Untested and may be volatile

[size=4][b]Standalone mod[/b][/size]
Hire Skilled Helpers works independently of Stardew Economy. Stardew Economy is not required but feel free to donwload

Please report any encountered bugs to the bugs page in nexus, be as descrptive as possible, ensure to include the logs if you can. Turn on verbose logging via GMCM if possible
